description: Xiaomi Cloud desktop client for Windows - sync photos, notes, contacts and drive files across devices.
##: Windows 64-bit build only; the vendor also publishes an ia32 installer and a macOS dmg.

The NSIS installer embeds the real app as $PLUGINSDIR\app-64.7z; installer.script expands it and removes installer leftovers. It cannot be post_install: Scoop creates shims and shortcuts before that hook runs, and the main exe still lives inside app-64.7z.
The vendor uninstaller sits in $R0\Uninstall 小米云服务.exe, so installer.script removes $R0 along with $PLUGINSDIR and $TEMP. The driveSync\ folder belongs to the GUI installer and is left in place.

3.0.2 moved to the archive/download/full-release/... channel. The old archive/update-server/public/... channel stops at 2.5.4, and the static mi-lab.htm page still advertises 1.2.5; using that page for checkver would trigger a downgrade PR.

checkver reads the winx64 URL from /api/v1/releases and captures both the version and the full download URL; autoupdate.url reuses $matchWinurl so a CDN hostname or path change is followed automatically.
autoupdate.hash uses download mode: the vendor publishes no SHA-256, so Excavator downloads the installer and computes it.
